warmup: Knock, knock! Someone’s at the clubhouse door. Press Listen to the knock. Then tap the door to knock the same rhythm back. Knocks close together make a group. Then find the code key. What did the knock mean?
part1: This red key works a flashlight. Tap it quickly for a short flash, a dot. Hold it down for a long flash, a dash. Send SOS first. Watch your strip below. A flash that’s in between gets a question mark!
explore: Here’s the judges’ first race code. Press Test across the creek, then read the test sheet. Which messages got mixed up? Change just one thing, a tile or the gap, and test again. Keep going until your partner reads four out of four!
evidence: A classmate says real engineers get it right the first time. Do you agree? Think about the judges’ first test, and race night in the mist. Pick your side, tap two facts in the planner, then explain. That’s your C-E-R.
